Hi Elena —

Thanks again for the conversation yesterday. Per our discussion I pulled together a focused renewal approach that aims to protect Stratos from short-term rate volatility while giving you capacity headroom to expand. High-level summary below — full numbers attached in the pricing sheet.

Option A — Price-hold + staged commit (recommended)
- 12-month renewal with a 6-month price-hold on current list rate (protects vs. any platform-wide increases)
- Staged committed units: 40% year-1 guaranteed, + optional 30% mid-year true-up window (discounted uplift pricing)
- One-time onboarding credit: $40k applied to Q1 invoices if you accelerate migration of three models to Dedicated.

Option B — Flat discount + flexible true-up
- 12-month renewal with a 10% list discount across consumed tokens (no price-hold)
- Monthly true-up allowed, but at a lower uplift (higher marginal price)

We designed Option A to be aggressive on near-term protection (price-hold) while retaining growth upside with the staged commit. If procurement needs a price-hold longer than 6 months we can discuss a limited extension for an incremental commit.

Next steps: if this aligns, I can send a clean term sheet and DocuSign for Signature and loop in finance/legal for the amendment. I’ve cc’d Lauren to help with the term language and procurement logistics.

Thanks —
